title: Eleven Years and One Name
subtitle: 信誉与评价 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 信誉与评价（社会服务与人际沟通·信用与评价）
meta: 主题语境：信誉与评价（社会服务与人际沟通·信用与评价）　|　核心词汇：credit　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 credit 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my grandfather ① gave a credit that no bank of his would have matched, and he said the giving was the whole of the trade. The ② credit, meaning the trust and not the money, ran eleven years and stayed unpaid; credit, he said, is the only thing in a ledger that is judged by how long it is left open.

Every ③ credit in that shop had the same name against it, and the ④ credit at the end, meaning the one he kept for the widows and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Credit, my grandmother said, is nine parts name and one part somebody willing to trust; my grandfather said the trusting is the part that fills eleven years.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the credit was the whole of the course, meaning the unit and not the trust. The ⑥ credit, meaning the unit and not any of that, is the only thing in a course that everybody counts and nobody learns; credit, she said, is either something you give or the only word that means both a trust and a unit. He said the unit is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ credit had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the name. The ⑧ credit of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in May, was one shop and thirty years of trusting; credit, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to trust. She said the trusting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ credit I remember is the one at the end, which was settled in 1971 and is still described as the longest in the county. A ⑩ credit, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being trusted; every credit, she said, is a unit that has agreed to look like a trust. She said the unit was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 信用（指那份信任本身，与那笔钱相对）
C. 固定搭配：give a credit 给予赊账
D. n. 赊账（指那家店里每一笔）
E. n. 赊账（指末尾那一笔）
F. n. 学分（课程计量的单位）
G. n. 信用（指报告里提到的那一笔）
H. n. 信誉；声望（抽象总称）

items.q: gave a credit that no bank of his would have matched
The credit, meaning the trust and not the money
the credit was the whole of the course
the credit had become a line in a report
The credit of the whole thing
A credit, my grandmother said in 1973

answers.why: give a credit 意为“给予赊账”，1957 年祖父给了一笔他的任何一家银行都不会肯的赊账。
credit 意为“信用”，指那份信任本身而不是那笔钱，它挂了十一年没有结清。
credit 指那家店里每一笔赊账，每一笔旁边都记着同一个名字。
credit 指末尾那一笔（他留给寡妇们的那笔），是唯一有人谢过两次的。
credit 意为“学分”，母亲说学分就是那门课的全部，指的是学分单位而不是那份信任。
credit 为教育用法，指课程的学分单位而不是那份信任，是课程里人人都计算、却无人去学的东西。
credit 意为“信用”，指报告里提到的那一笔，到 1965 年这笔信用成了报告里的一行。
credit 意为“信誉、声望”，祖父五月写道，整件事的信誉是一家店三十年的信任。
credit 意为“信用、赊账”，我记得的是末尾那一笔，1971 年结清，至今仍被说成全县挂得最久的。
credit 为抽象总称，祖母说一笔信用是唯一会因为被信任而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年祖父给了一笔他的任何一家银行都不会肯的赊账，他说给才是这整笔生意的全部。（give a credit）
那份信用，指的是那份信任本身而不是那笔钱，挂了十一年没有结清，并且一直是那样。（credit）
那家店里每一笔赊账旁边都记着同一个名字。（credit）
末尾那一笔赊账，指的是他留给寡妇们的那笔，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（credit）
母亲说学分就是那门课的全部，指的是学分单位而不是那份信任。（credit）
1973 年祖母说，一笔信用是唯一会因为被信任而变好的东西。（credit）
answers: In 1957 my grandfather gave a credit that no bank of his would have matched, and he said the giving was the whole of the trade.
The credit, meaning the trust and not the money, ran eleven years and stayed unpaid.
Every credit in that shop had the same name against it.
The credit at the end, meaning the one he kept for the widows and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My mother said the credit was the whole of the course, meaning the unit and not the trust.
A credit, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being trusted.
